title: Behavioral Finance — Mind vs Money 🧠
description: Dimag aur paise ka connection samjho. System 1 vs System 2 thinking, Money personality types, aur Cognitive biases.

cards.title: System 1 vs System 2 Thinking 🧠
cards.content:
Why do smart people make dumb money choices?

**Fast Brain (System 1)**: Emotional, instant, 50% OFF board dekhte hi buy kar lena.
**Slow Brain (System 2)**: Logical, budget calculation, "kya sach mein zaroorat hai?".

Money decisions mein System 1 dominant hota hai — isliye sale dekh ke ₹15,000 spend ho jaate hain!

| Feature | Traditional Finance | Behavioral Finance |
|---|---|---|
| Assumption | Humans are rational | Humans are emotional |
| Decision | Logic only | Feelings + Logic |
| Goal | Maximize ROI | Prevent mistakes |
cards.imagePrompt: Brain split into two halves: one glowing fast emotional side with shopping bags, one logical calm side with graphs, neon purple art

choiceData.scenario: Amazon Great Indian Festival: 50% OFF ad dekhte hi pehla thought kya aata hai?

choices.text: Fast Brain: Abhi order maaro, mauka dubara nahi aayega!
choices.consequence: System 1 Trap! Sale emergency nahi hai, budget out ho jayega.

choices.text: Slow Brain: Pause 24 hours, check if it fits monthly budget.

cards.title: 5 Money Personality Types 🎭
cards.content:
Tumhara money personality type kya hai?

1. **The Saver**: Money safe rakhta hai, par inflation se wealth lose karta hai.
2. **The Spender**: Impulse buyer, peer pressure, credit card trap risk.
3. **The Investor**: Returns focus, over-trading bias risk.
4. **The Giver**: Extra generous, personal safety net ignore karna.
5. **The Avoider**: Money talk se bhagna, hidden penalties accumulate karna.
cards.imagePrompt: Five characters standing together representing Saver, Spender, Investor, Giver, and Avoider, purple and gold illustration

quizData.question: Aapki bank balance dekhne se darr lagta hai aur bills delay hote hain. Profile kya hai?
quizData.explanation: The Avoider status! Financial date fixed karke step-by-step audit shuru karein.

cards.title: Top Cognitive Biases ⚠️
cards.content:
**1. Anchoring Bias**: MRP ₹2,000 dekh ke ₹999 sasta lagna (actual value ₹300).
**2. Loss Aversion**: Loss ka dukh profit ki khushi se 2.5x zyada hota hai.
**3. Herd Mentality**: Crypto/IPO boom mein sab ke saath blind invest karna.
**4. Sunk Cost Fallacy**: Useless course mein ₹10k lag gaye toh time bhi waste karna.
cards.imagePrompt: Mind with gears and warning badges for financial cognitive biases, purple background graphic

choiceData.scenario: Boring course pe ₹8,000 de chuke ho. Baaki 20 hours watching continues ya quit?

choices.text: Sunk Cost Fallacy: Paise diye hain toh poora dekhoonga
choices.consequence: Wrong! ₹8,000 already gone, now 20 hours time also wasted.

choices.text: Smart Cut: Quit course, focus on productive skills
choices.consequence: Right! Sunk cost leave karke future benefit maximize kiya.

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Behavioral Nudge Setup
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

Nudges apply karke smart decisions automatic banao:

- [ ] Auto-debit setup for savings (out of sight, out of mind).
- [ ] 24-hour rule apply karo ₹500+ impulse purchase pe.
- [ ] Shopping apps phone se uninstall / notifications OFF karo.
- [ ] Weekly expense log alarm 9 PM fix karo.
